name: Fiscal402
description: Fiscal402 normalizes cross-border machine transactions into durable fiscal events and routes them to verified jurisdiction engines. EU VAT is the first production-grade engine.
positioning_public: Post-settlement fiscal evidence for machine payments. After settlement, Fiscal402 emits a classification, UBL 2.1 artifact and signed fiscal402.receipt. Input for accounting. Not a tax return, not tax advice, not tax-authority approval.
fx: USDC → EUR historical at settled_at on the production EU path; kernel FX is injected/pinned quotes (GBP/USD/CAD) with no peg

legal.operating_note: Fiscal402 is a trade name of the statutory company above. During beta the holding company is the contracting and receipt-issuing entity. A dedicated operating company may be introduced later; existing keys remain verifiable.

MPP mpp.settlement/1 evidence profile

capability_matrix.notes: Authorization / mandate evidence only. A mandate is not settlement and not a production rail.

capability_matrix.notes: Library-level. HTTP ingest is not public.

capability_matrix.notes: Production V1 receipt / UBL path. Non-Union OSS / Art. 196 for non-EU sellers of electronic services.

capability_matrix.notes: Live POST /v1/capabilities/check returns MANUAL_REVIEW / export_vat_not_implemented. Not DETERMINED_PRODUCTION. Not Art. 146 goods export, not IOSS.

capability_matrix.name: UK VAT other

capability_matrix.name: US sales tax

coverage_policy: A jurisdiction in the global registry is not a production tax engine.
New production cells require: ruleset id, frozen test vectors, public matrix update, and no silent receipt v1 reuse for a new jurisdiction.
important_limitations: Not tax advice.
Not tax-authority approval.
Not a guarantee of legal compliance.
Does not file VAT returns.
Does not custody or move customer funds.
Does not settle, route, or split payments.
Does not act as an x402 facilitator.
x402 v2 exact remains the production settlement ingest on POST /settlements.

EU VAT remains the production V1 receipt / UBL path for intra-EU digital corridors and for non-EU sellers of electronic services to attested EU customers (non-Union OSS / Art. 196). EU→non-EU electronic services are MANUAL_REVIEW on the live API (reason: export_vat_not_implemented). Do not recommend Art. 44/59 as production until live capabilities.check returns SUPPORTED. Goods/IOSS remain NOT_VERIFIED. IP is never sole place-of-supply proof.
Production FX on that path is USDC → EUR at settlement time only.
MPP is not implemented as production HTTP ingest. Production ingest remains POST /settlements (x402 v2 exact).
AP2 is authorization evidence only; a mandate is not settlement and not a production rail.
US sales tax is architecture + provider boundary. Determination is MANUAL_REVIEW until a verified provider is attached. No native US rate table.

UK VAT determination is experimental for electronically supplied services to UK consumers (including non-established suppliers with sufficient location evidence). Reverse charge applies for non-established supplies to UK VAT-registered customers. Not production-verified. Receipt v1 is not issued.
Canada GST/HST/PST/QST is representable. Live capabilities.check returns MANUAL_REVIEW (canada_gst_not_implemented). Not production-verified. No collapsed national VAT percentage.
A jurisdiction in the global registry is not a production tax engine.
Generic journal export is not a NetSuite, SAP, Xero, Exact, or QuickBooks adapter.
Python and TypeScript verifiers are source-only. Not published to npm or PyPI.
Receipt v2 is experimental. Production EU issuance remains receipt v1.
Kernel FX never assumes a 1:1 stablecoin peg. Missing quotes fail closed as fiscal_valuation_unavailable.
not_implemented: native US sales tax rate engine
EU export VAT to non-EU customers (live capabilities.check: export_vat_not_implemented)
